title: Extra spaces in a name are removed before it is saved
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: You create a new term whose name was typed with extra spaces around and between its words.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • A name, {Term-A}, made of two words, that no term has.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S3-18 Two Words.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type {Term-A} with two spaces before it, three spaces between two of its words and one space after it.
  3. Type 14 in the Days box.
  4. Click "Create Credit Term".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Credit Term" window opens.
  • Step 2: the Name shows the extra spaces.
  • Step 3: the blue information line shows below the options.
  • Step 4: the toast and the new row show {Term-A} with single spaces and no space before or after it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
